notes:
• Built-in 4K wallpapers: three original wallpapers for each mode, rendered at 3840×2560 and drawn for TabStation (free to use, not taken from Apple or Microsoft).
  - macOS: Dusk, Mist, Ocean
  - Windows: Bloom, Aurora, Prism
• Change wallpaper: right-click or long-press the desktop → "Change wallpaper…" opens a gallery with previews: the presets, "My picture", "Upload picture…" and the HyperOS wallpaper. The same gallery is in Settings → Appearance → Wallpaper. Each mode keeps its own choice.
• Your own picture is kept when you pick a preset or the HyperOS wallpaper, so you can switch back any time. "Use system wallpaper" no longer deletes it.
• New installs start with a preset. If you update and never set a TabStation wallpaper, you keep the HyperOS wallpaper as before.
• Windows mode: tapping a window's "•••" handle no longer leaves TabStation's window buttons on top of the HyperOS window menu.

Requires Android 10+. Shizuku is recommended. Install over the previous version; settings are kept. TabStation updates itself from Settings → Version & updates.
